companies.name: Just In Case Direct
companies.distributes: Hotel minibar and conference products: chocolate, confectionery (Jelly Belly, Skittles, Kelly's Candy, Funday Sweets, Jila Mints), biscuits (Kez's Cookies, Future Bake), salty snacks (Pringles, Smith's, Red Rock Deli, Cobs) and healthy snacks
companies.channels_supplied: Hotels, accommodation providers, conferences and conventions, events and welcome packs, Australia wide and abroad
companies.sf_brands_carried: Healthy Products section with better-for-you snacks such as Cobs popcorn, Grainwaves and Harvest Box; no sugar-free confectionery seen
companies.fit_rationale: A specialist hotel minibar wholesaler offering over 250 minibar lines, most of them other companies' branded chocolate, confectionery, biscuits and snacks. Its Healthy Products section shows hotels already ask it for better-for-you lines, which suits Diablo's no-added-sugar chocolate, gummies and cookies. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Offers over 250 minibar lines across biscuits, chocolate, confectionery, salty snacks and healthy products for hotels.

companies.name: LePack Accommodation Supplies

companies.channels_supplied: Hotels, motels, resorts, serviced apartments, Airbnb hosts, clubs, conference venues and tour groups, Australia wide
companies.sf_brands_carried: Better-for-you snacks from Brookfarm and Springhill Farm; no sugar-free brand seen
companies.fit_rationale: An accommodation supply wholesaler with its own Snacks, Jams and Spreads and Minibar sections selling other companies' biscuits, bars and snacks to hotels and short stay hosts. Diablo's wafers, cookies, bars and portion jams fit straight into its guest room and snack pack ranges. Storage: assembles and ships snack and breakfast packs from its own premises on the Gold Coast.
what_they_do_well: Has supplied hotels, motels and resorts since 2006, with breakfast and snack packs assembled at its own premises.

companies.name: Hotel Products Direct

companies.channels_supplied: Hotels, motels, guesthouses, inns, serviced apartments, B&Bs and youth hostels, Australia wide through its online shop
companies.fit_rationale: An online accommodation supplier with biscuits, chocolates and mints and jams sections stocked with other companies' brands for guest rooms. Diablo's individually wrapped chocolates, biscuits and portion jams match what it already sells to hotels. Storage: sells from its own stock through its online shop, warehouse not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Over 20 years supplying commercial accommodation products to hotels, motels and serviced apartments across Australia.

companies.name: National Hotel Supplies

companies.channels_supplied: Accommodation industry Australia wide through its online shop

Diablo's biscuits, wafers and sweets fit this range directly. Tier 3 because its website names neither its head office city nor its warehouse. Storage: sells from its own stock through its online shop, warehouse not named on its website.

companies.name: Honesty Snacks
companies.distributes: Monthly snack subscription boxes of 40 to 80 branded snacks, including chocolate (Cadbury, Mars), sweets and mints (Mentos, Jila Mints), muesli and snack bars (Carman's, Bounce, Emma & Tom's) and chips, with Sweets and Treats, Healthy and mixed boxes.
companies.channels_supplied: Workplaces and homes, by subscription from its own online shop, with its own drivers in Melbourne and Adelaide and courier delivery Australia-wide.
companies.sf_brands_carried: Slim Secrets (low sugar), Carman's, Bounce, Blue Dinosaur, So Vegan and other better-for-you brands in its Healthy and Better For You boxes.
companies.fit_rationale: A subscription business built on well-known third-party snack brands, with dedicated Healthy Snack and Better For You boxes where Diablo's sugar-free chocolate, bars and cookies fit. It delivers recurring boxes to offices and homes, which gives steady repeat volume. It carries Slim Secrets, a low sugar brand that competes with Diablo. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Runs its own delivery drivers in Melbourne and Adelaide and ships subscription boxes Australia-wide.
Says it has supplied quality snacks for over 40 years, with a brand line-up including Cadbury, Mars, Carman's and Slim Secrets.

companies.name: Treat Crate
companies.based_out_of: Australia (head office city not stated on its website)
companies.distributes: Monthly international snack subscription boxes of chips, chocolates, candy, biscuits, cakes and drinks from a different country each month, including the UK, Germany, Hungary, Sweden and France.
companies.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers by subscription and one-off Instant Crates from its own online shop, delivered Australia-wide (prices also shown in NZD).
companies.fit_rationale: Australia's self-described number one international snack subscription, buying branded packaged snacks from many countries and reselling them as they are in themed monthly crates. Its boxes already cover chocolate, candy, biscuits and cakes, and it features UK and European countries, which suits a UK exporter such as Diablo. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Has run a monthly international snack subscription since October 2018, shipping Australia-wide.

companies.fit_rationale: A lolly shop that runs a monthly Candy Club subscription box and stocks imported UK and US sweets and chocolate, so Diablo's gummies and chocolate fit its range. what_they_do_well: Runs a Candy Club monthly subscription box alongside its Byron Bay shop and corporate gift boxes.

what_they_do_well: Australian owned and operated for over ten years, claiming more than 130,000 customers served Australia-wide.

Lists Netflix, Samsung, Afterpay and L'Oreal Paris among clients.
